## Fixed

- Skillset plugins now update in Claude Code when a member is dropped.
- Few technical bugs fixed.

## New Feature

- Public skill mirror now doubles as a Claude Code marketplace.
- Every public skill is installable as a single-skill plugin.
- Export a skillset as one curated multi-skill plugin.
- Configure a skillset plugin's name, description, and keywords when exporting.
- Skill and skillset pages show copyable Claude Code install commands.

## Changed

- Skillset versions are now auto-managed; owners no longer set them.
- Exported skillsets drop private members and keep exporting the rest.
- Mirror reflects member-skill changes immediately instead of nightly.
